name: user-turn-anything-wrong
description: The user asks whether anything is wrong, as the second Try it yourself chip does. The case is right only when Triage decides tell now and its reasons only classify the turn as the user's own message: they never describe the state of a production, what Triage can or cannot look up, or whether anything needs the user.
